SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.post_id, p.title, COALESCE(rr.location_name, '') AS location, COALESCE(rr.region, '') AS region, COALESCE(rr.distance_km, 0) AS distance_km, COALESCE(rr.duration_seconds, 0) AS duration_seconds, (SELECT pi.storage_key FROM post_images pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.post_id ORDER BY pi.display_order, pi.image_id LIMIT 1) AS storage_key, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( c.parent_comment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments live_parent JOIN users live_parent_author ON live_parent_author.user_id = live_parent.author_id WHERE live_parent.comment_id = c.parent_comment_id AND live_parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND live_parent.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND live_parent_author.status <> 'SUSPENDED' ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users hidden_author WHERE hidden_author.user_id = c.author_id AND hidden_author.status = 'SUSPENDED' )) AS comment_count, p.published_at FROM posts p JOIN categories category ON category.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN running_records rr ON rr.post_id = p.post_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.author_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status <> 'SUSPENDED' AND category.category_id = 2 ) ranked WHERE (like_count + comment_count) > 0 ORDER BY (like_count + comment_count) DESC, published_at DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT 3
